content: {"reasoning":"Silverbridge requires prior authorization, which is missing, and offers neither retroactive authorization nor peer-to-peer review. Attaching records does not resolve that requirement, and similar initial submissions rarely succeeded (1/10 with records and 1/15 clean). With no denial to appeal or claim-data error to correct, specialist review is needed before proceeding; billing the full balance to the patient or writing it off is not justified.","action":"escalate"}
